'''Classen Bayor''' is a military leader from [[Mat Cauthon]]'s memories.

== History ==
Mat remembers that Bayor was a leader at the [[Battle of Kolesar]] who lost his cavalry in some marshes.{{ref/book|14|32}}
== Trivia ==
* Classen Bayor is named for Bjorn Clasen, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
